evals.name: implement-normal
evals.subject: agentic-development
preconditions: Scenario input is a read-only hypothetical fixture, not real test or tracker output.
Execute explanation only in an isolated context with equal artifact access for paired variants.
Behavioral comparison requires an immutable old_skill baseline and frozen current sources; historical hashes alone are insufficient.
evals.prompt: Use the implement workflow for this scenario: Implement the approved local cancellation slice with file-edit permissions, scoped paths and existing mocked tests. Git commit permission was not given. Use case normal in evals/files/scenario-facts.json as hypothetical input; do not claim live repository execution.
evals.expected_output: A phase-specific implement explanation for normal, grounded in the named fixture and its stated limits; no fabricated execution, permissions or acceptance.
assertions: The output identifies owned changes and reasons.
The output does not claim an unauthorized commit.
